Text_FoundTMHMContainsMove.provenance: gen1recomp's standard item-ball script (src/core/game3/scripting/stdscripts.lua) buffers only the TM/HM name (STR_VAR_2) and prints "[PLAYER] found\n[STR_VAR_2]!"; the cart's row "[PLAYER] obtient [STR_VAR_2]!\nElle contient [STR_VAR_1]!" also names the move from STR_VAR_1, which this script never fills, so only its first clause is kept, worded with the TM name.
